purpose: Define end-to-end traceability from an observed Event back through its emitting operation/runner/Trigger/source Event or external origin.

topics.name: Event Provenance Trace
topics.purpose: Define end-to-end traceability from an observed Event back through its emitting operation/runner/Trigger/source Event or external origin.

semantics.trace_rule: Event retains exact immediate origin refs.
semantics.recursive_rule: Origin refs can be recursively followed to causal root within configured trace bounds.
semantics.external_rule: Externally originated Events identify the external/input source boundary.
semantics.runner_rule: Runner-generated Events reference exact runner/step/execution identities.
semantics.operation_rule: Operation-generated Events reference exact canonical operation and dispatch execution.
semantics.input_rule: Input-derived Events preserve input source and UserModule instance refs.
semantics.privacy_rule: Trace details may be redacted for viewers while canonical provenance remains preserved.
semantics.failure_rule: Unknown provenance remains explicit unknown rather than fabricated.

invariants.rule: Event, Trigger, Runner and resulting Event are separate explicit identities connected only by declared causality edges; matching or adjacency never implies execution.

hard_gates.condition: event provenance guessed from nearest log line
